files.description: Raw HTML of the EHI export documentation page. Contains the full text of the (b)(10) export documentation including export workflow descriptions, format specifications, and a 69-row C-CDA data dictionary table.
files.curl_command: curl -sL 'https://ehryourway.com/electronic-health-information-export/' -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36' -o ehi-export-page.html

files.description: Screenshot of the top of the EHI export page showing the heading, compliance statement, supported export capabilities, export formats, and access controls sections.
Screenshot of the middle section showing export workflows (single patient and bulk export), export format specification text, and the beginning of the C-CDA data dictionary table.
Full-page screenshot capturing the entire EHI export documentation page including all text and the complete C-CDA data dictionary table.
Structured JSON extraction of the C-CDA data dictionary table. Contains 69 data elements organized across 28 C-CDA sections with data element names, entry/XPath references, and code system OIDs.
Bun TypeScript extraction script that parses the HTML page and produces the structured JSON data dictionary. Deterministic and rerunnable.
Documentation for the enrichment pipeline: run commands, input boundary, output files, and known parsing limitations.
